outcome: Gut microbiota composition (Bacteroidetes, Proteobacteria, Fusobacteria, 24 different taxa)
Serum inflammatory factors (tumor necrosis factor-α, Interleukin-6, Interleukin-4, Interleukin-10)
cohort: The study participants were 41 preeclampsia patients and 45 age- and pre-pregnancy body mass index-matched healthy pregnant controls.
finding: Preeclampsia patients demonstrated significant gut microbiota disturbances, including lower α diversity and specific phylum-level differences, and increasing serum proinflammatory factors (TNF-α and IL-6) compared to healthy pregnant women.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from November 2021 to May 2022
